assessment: This study provides valuable information on the single nucleus RNA sequencing transcriptome, pathways, and cell types in pig skeletal muscle in response to conjugated linoleic acid (CLA) supplementation. Based on the comprehensive data analyses, the data are considered compelling and provide new insight into the mechanisms underlying intramuscular fat deposition and muscle fiber remodeling. The study contributes significantly to the understanding of nutritional strategies for fat infiltration in pig muscle.
